breakdown.description: Numerical method section contains conflicting time-integration / solver instructions.
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve the conflict between the two specified time integration methods. The original prompt incorrectly listed both "Explicit forward Euler" and the more detailed "Strang splitting" method. The ground truth resolves this by removing the "Explicit forward Euler" instruction entirely. The agent, however, incorrectly combined the two, stating: "Use Strang splitting time integration with explicit forward Euler." This is not what the ground truth specifies and fails to correct the ambiguity.
